_note: Standard payroll data dictionary: inputs every employer's payroll data keeps beyond the case schema, with their meaning. Rules read them with the accessor named by the group (income, benefit, hr, employee, employer). A company adds its own fields in workspace/payroll_inputs.json.

income.fixed_allowance: fixed regular allowances paid every month
income.thr: religious holiday allowance (THR) paid this month
income.deductions: other deductions from income this month
income.jkk_premium: work accident premium (JKK) actually billed for the employee this month
income.jkm_premium: death premium (JKM) actually billed for the employee this month
income.health_premium_employer: health premium (JKN) paid by the employer for the employee this month
income.health_employee: health premium (JKN) paid by the employee this month
income.jht_employee: old-age savings contribution (JHT) paid by the employee this month
income.jp_employee: pension contribution (JP) paid by the employee this month

benefit.company_vehicle: value of a company vehicle provided to the employee this month
benefit.housing_individual: value of housing provided to the employee alone this month
benefit.gift_other: value of gifts or other benefits in kind given this month
benefit.meal_coupon_field_duty: value of meals or meal coupons for field duty this month
benefit.sports_facility: value of sports facilities provided this month
benefit.other_benefit: value of other benefits in kind this month

hr.days_terminated_before_holiday: days between the end of employment and the religious holiday
hr.months_of_service: months of service with the employer
hr.night_shift_days: night shift days worked this month
hr.thr_holiday: the religious holiday the THR is paid for
hr.variable_sales_commission: variable sales commission earned this month

employee.avg_monthly_gross_12m: average monthly gross income of the last 12 months
employee.contract_fixed_income: fixed regular income agreed in the employment contract for the first month
employee.has_equity_in_employer: the employee holds equity in the employer
employee.known_last_month: the last month of employment is known in advance
employee.other_dtp_incentive: the employee already receives another government-borne (DTP) income tax incentive

employer.bonded_zone: the employer operates in a bonded zone
employer.kite: the employer holds an import facility for export purposes (KITE)
employer.bpjs_relief_2020_eligible: the employer qualified for the 2020 social security contribution relief
employer.premiums_as_billed: premiums follow the amounts actually billed by BPJS
employer.workplace_meal_value: value of meals provided at the workplace
